text:
I am unconvinced by my pkm. I have spent ages trying to make it something useful but it is just a dopamine fix. I am addicted to it. I organise it and use LLM to tidy up notes and automatically add links and it all feels very satisfying but I am not using it as a tool that is helping me. Most knowledge work can be done with AI now and so I don't need to collect knowledge. And I don't write my own thoughts out. I write my thoughts into an LLM and have a few back and forth until I am happy. Like now. But I am not using my prodos system for productivity. 
Is there anything I can do to make my obsidian LLM prodos cos system actually useful without scraping everything
